response: Ward N (Ghatkopar, Vikhroli) has billed INR 5999557 against a budget of INR 6200000, using 96.8% of it across 112 repair jobs. Of these, 19.6% were reopened within 30 days, and 54.5% met the promised completion time. Conditions may explain part of this: the ward has a low-lying index of 0.55, and the city saw 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season. INR 705327 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs there should cost the city nothing. This needs review. Also, 6 jobs were priced more than 30% above the rate card and should be checked. The top contractor by spend is Arabian Sea Engineering (synthetic). Example work orders are WO25-00024 and WO25-00287. Ask the ward office whether WO25-00024 was on a DLP road and, if so, why the city paid for it.
